project_title: Assistant d'entretien IA - Real-Time Interview Companion

theme.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Precision & High-Focus Live Companion)

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

font_sizes.candidate_bold_highlight: font-black text-amber-300 bg-amber-950/40 px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-500/30

layout_and_structure.spacing_philosophy: Generous tactical spacing. High visual contrast between control zones and live stream output.
layout_and_structure.layout_grid: 3-Column Responsive Grid on Desktop (Left: Session Context & History, Center: Live Copilot/Simulator Workspace, Right: Live Voice Analytics & State Inspector)

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: Single column view with tabbed panels for Context / Live Assistant / Voice Stats
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: Full 3-column command center with floating barge-in controls

NEUTRE.description: Initial clarification state asking candidate to confirm role/mode
NEUTRE.ui_element: Prompt card with dual CTA buttons: 'Activer Mode Candidat' (Live Copilot) & 'Activer Mode Recruteur' (Simulation)

CANDIDAT.description: Live stealth copilot mode for candidate during interview
CANDIDAT.rules: 3 telegraphic bullet points <= 12 words per bullet. 2-3 bolded words per bullet. Progressive reveal 1->2->3 with 0.15s staggering.

RECRUTEUR.description: Immersive interview simulator. One question at a time, natural prose. Zero bullets, zero bold.

key_features_and_components.session_context_panel: Tabbed card containing Candidate CV summary, Job Description (Fiche de poste), Company Info (Entreprise), and Sector intelligence (Secteur). Allows inline editing/upload.

live_voice_analytics.realtime_stt: Live French speech-to-text transcript banner with waveform audio visualizer
live_voice_analytics.gauges: Stress level meter, Monotone index gauge, Speaking rate (mots/min), Voice Confidence % gauge

visual_logic_parser.file_upload: Image drag-and-drop zone for logical matrix tests or domino puzzles
visual_logic_parser.response_format: [RÉPONSE: X] bold badge output with breakdown of logic pattern

turn_counter_and_barge_in.barge_in_button: Red alert 'Interrompre / Reprendre la parole' button for instant candidate takeover

debug_overlay.drawer: Exposes raw state machine telemetry, LLM latency (ms), token consumption, STT raw buffer, and confidence scores

key_features_and_components.session_history: Collapsible sidebar listing previous interview sessions with score summary, date, role title, and export options

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this design guidelines JSON before implementing front-end React code.
Implement the UI using Tailwind CSS, standard Lucide icons, and Shadcn UI components located at src/components/ui/.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='mode-candidat-btn', data-testid='voice-input-toggle', data-testid='barge-in-btn').
Enforce French language throughout all user-facing labels, badges, buttons, tooltips, and placeholder text.
Implement the deterministic state machine transitions smoothly with visual feedback: NEUTRE -> CANDIDAT or RECRUTEUR.
In Mode CANDIDAT, enforce the 3-bullet constraint with progressive reveal (1->2->3) and bold keywords highlight styling.
Include real-time voice gauge simulation (stress, monotone, rate, confidence) with audio animation effects.
Provide image drag and drop for visual logic tests with immediate AI breakdown and [RÉPONSE: X] tag.
Provide a toggleable Debug overlay displaying real-time state machine logs and telemetry.
Preserve responsive layout with dark glassmorphism surfaces and crisp contrast.
